action: Support 2027 Round 1 Site Development Grant applications
window: LOIs closed Oct 15; applications due Nov 19
summary: TNECD Select Tennessee SDG, up to $5.0M per site (due diligence grants up to $100K). Governmental applicants only; site must be publicly owned (with exceptions) and at least 20 acres (10 acres in Tier 3 and 4 counties). Full applications due 2026-11-19.
steps:
Greg: by 2026-11-06, confirm which SMTN counties filed LOIs on 2026-10-15 and that each applicant is on track in SmartSimple.
County/IDB applicants: complete full applications in SmartSimple by 2026-11-19.
Greg: use current tiers (effective 2026-07-01) when advising on match. Tier 1: Marshall, Maury, Moore. Tier 2: Bedford, Coffee, Franklin, Giles, Hickman, Lincoln. Tier 3: Lawrence, Lewis. Tier 4: Perry (Distressed), Wayne (At Risk).
Greg: remind applicants of tier match (Tier 1 50/50, Tier 2 70/30, Tier 3 90/10, Tier 4 95/5), halved for sites with a Certified Sites visit.

action: Alert SMTN electric cooperatives to USDA ARC letter-of-interest window
summary: USDA Rural Utilities Service Affordable Rural Cooperative program: loans and grants to rural electric co-ops for nuclear energy and transmission efficiency projects. Letters of interest from 11:59 a.m. ET 2026-10-19 to 11:59 a.m. ET 2026-11-20 via grants.gov. Grants capped at 25% of total award costs and $20M.
steps:
Greg: by 2026-11-06, confirm the notice reached the electric co-ops serving SMTN counties (e.g., Duck River EMC, Meriwether Lewis Electric Cooperative).
Co-ops: contact their RUS General Field Representative and submit letters of interest by 2026-11-20.

summary: $45M tower plant, 212 jobs (revised), full commissioning by end of 2027 at Runway Centre Industrial Park.
steps:
Greg: by 2026-11-13, meet Fayetteville-Lincoln County IDB and Motlow State on welding/fabrication training capacity (rolled from 2026-10-30).
Note the job revision (230 to 212) in any talking points.

action: Maury County: Ultium LMR retool and supplier watch
summary: Ultium Cells $1B retool announced 2026-09-29; 500 projected jobs reported. Track supplier and workforce impacts across Maury, Marshall, Giles and Bedford.
steps:
Greg: ask Maury Alliance for the hiring timeline and any supplier site requests.
Keep rapid-response contacts current with TCAT Pulaski and TCAT Shelbyville in case of production gaps during retooling.

action: Brief county partners on the TNTalent workforce fund
summary: $5M in federal funding through TNWorks for employer workforce development in nuclear energy, AI infrastructure and advanced manufacturing (TDLWD, 2026-10-15).
steps:
Greg: by 2026-11-13, share TNWorks.com with Stella-Jones (Lincoln), Ultium Cells and Medacta (Maury) contacts via their EDCs (rolled from 2026-10-30).
EDCs: route interested employers to request a TNWorks meeting.

action: Marshall County: prepare for TNECD housing market analysis
summary: Marshall is the only SMTN county among 14 selected 2026-10-27 for a TNECD housing market analysis by Points Consulting, including a site visit.
steps:
Greg: by 2026-11-13, ask TNECD Community & Rural Development for the site-visit date and the local point of contact.
Marshall County/Lewisburg: assemble permit data, planned subdivisions and employer housing feedback before the visit.

action: Downtown Improvement Grant recipients: Centerville, Collinwood, Mount Pleasant
summary: Centerville $300,000, Collinwood $125,000 and Mount Pleasant $325,000 in TNECD Downtown Improvement Grants; 25% local match required.
steps:
Greg: by 2026-11-13, send congratulations to the three communities and confirm each has its 25% match committed.
Communities: track TNECD contracting steps and use the projects in downtown marketing to prospects.
